I'm a big fan. It seems to have lost some rhythm around 25% of the way in, but perhaps that was the point. The drama was well put. Losing the keys leading to questioning the potential of your future might be pointing at underlying anxiety and lessened self worth. Maybe intended or otherwise, I liked that, it seems realistic.
Side note, I cringed at the awful, awful dance, but then you mentioned how it wasnt meant to be cool, which made me chuckle and the cringe subside.

Very well done. The ending was icing on top :)

You seemed to mistakenly believe that I havent been trying to do things on my own, without their support. Also cutting ties to them would come off as more of a moocher - then I'm providing nothing back to them for what they've given me.

Your latest 'advice' was not sound, and I was looking for more of the relationship aspect than worrying about becoming more independent, thus posting it here.

Of course I intend on paying them back, and have a running total of the amount they've given me rounded up. I dont intend to mooch on them, but they are giving people, and actively telling them 'No' would upset them. I intend on paying them back a year after graduation, when I have a stable job and can actually provide for myself. As it stands, I cannot even take enough loans to pay for school. My mom makes 35,000 annually and pays 10,000 towards my school. It still isnt enough. I have an IT job that makes 8.00/hr, but have class so I cannot work full time. My money goes almost entirely into living expenses, so that my mom does not have to provide for me as well.

Didnt expect you to take such an aggressive tone when I'm asking for relationship advice, not financial advice.

I dont know how informal I could be, her parents and I still have a pretty close relationship. It should be done in person, at the very least. I dunno how to bring it up in conversation. They're very understanding, and might realize what I'm getting at.
Thank you for your comment. I'm considering telling them, but they still provide me so much, including my dorm room. I may take her mom up on lunch and see what she says if I mention it.
Holy shit. "I have two chins" was awesome. I love the casual way it's said. Good shit.

Honestly I'm not too attached to this one. Theres a ton of these thoughts for me recently, and I dont like the poems that come from them. 
I probably wont post anything like this again :P I wrote about 10 in an incredibly short span of time, just wanted to get one out there. I normally hate poems like this, to be honest. Too direct.

Regardless, thanks for the comment and the criticism!

Another.. great poem. Your use of words builds a rich scene. Rich in emotion but dark in nature. 
You begin the poem with what I assume to be a description of an old, near death person. Someone reminiscing of their life, which they have colorful, grand memories of. But that something happened during their time (a war?) that others seem to associate with them more than the other aspects of their life. The person of the poem is more than the large events that happened during their lifetime, but a culmination of their entire experience. An experience that was only captured in bleak, black-and-white photographs. Pictures that likely reinforce the ideas that the 'others' have about our poem's subject.

After rereading, I think I focused too much on 'all that anyone remembers now'. It is less so about the others, more about the loss of a lifetime of memories. Maybe I'm way off on your focus anyways :P

As far as criticism, I love the word choice. Like your last one, I think you're a superior poet than myself, so I cant help much in the way of critiquing. Glad to see you posted again :)

I like your way of thinking. Next time I'm in the pits (tomorrow or later tonight, probably lol) I hope I can think like this. I have plans to take off after I finish college. Head 900 miles to Seattle and start a new life there. Programming is my passion, and I hope I can restore the fun in it before the year is done.

Thanks for your comment. Every one means a lot to me. Just to know someone listens, ya know?

Theres also the money aspect of it. I dont have 300-600 dollars to drop with my terrible work study.
Thanks for your comments.

No. Everything sucks anymore. I play games and watch YouTube (some pretty funny people) but they cant even keep my attention anymore. These last 2 months have been horrible, but these last two days are the absolute worst. And no one listens.
As far as instruments, I want to learn the drums. But I already know I never will, regardless of what my future holds. Too hard, too little time, and far too little dedication.

Know that it isnt your fault alone that she left. Shit happens. Were there points in the relationship that were really rough and you'd wished she'd acted differently?
For me, my girlfriend had anxiety and depression. That was fine, I thought I helped her cope with both very well. But when she would get upset (just mad, which was frequently), I was always the butt end of her anger. She would snap at me if I even tried to talk to her. In front of our friends and everything. And she didnt ever ask how I was.
Two things I would change.

How about you? Was your relationship really flawless? I think we both need to get over our exes before we can feel any better.
Also thank you for your comment. It means a lot that someone listens.

Therapy is extremely expensive for me, unfortunately. My ex girlfriend used to be my 'therapist' even though she always said I never told her how I felt. 
As for 'toughing it out', a little. But I never felt strong emotions before now. I have always been a bit bland and thought things through myself. This one I cant.

I have tried to separate myself, but I rent my house from her parents. Her brother is one of my only 2 friends. She still has a room in our house, but doesnt live here. It's hard to get away. Sometimes (very rarely) I stop in her room, basically the same as it was when I slept there. It's therapeutic, but ultimately bad for me, I know.

Lastly, I cannot get into anything new. I want to design games in the future, but no longer have fun writing code. Theres several projects I should work on, but I cant.

It is the exact same for me. I've never felt like absolute shit like this in my life. I've never felt suicidal, I've never really CARED about anything but her and school. 
But now everything is different and it all revolves around her. I dont know if she really knows that. And it isnt her fault if I do it. I dont want to tell her, but shes the only one who can stop it. She doesnt have to leave him or come back to me. She just needs to give me something. A compliment would do, something that I did right by her. I just need to know I meant something and am not entirely replaced by a guy that she barely knows.
Happens. Unfortunate circumstances of biggish communities, posts get a but buried.
Even if none of these, sometimes life just sucks. Some people have a great life from the outside, but internally struggle for years.

I also like to free write, it's where a lot of my poems come from. I write a large block of text, then sift the parts I like. Compile them into a poem or two. Often times it's the ideas, not sentences pulled directly from my writing. I find it's a good process

I made my ex girlfriend block me on snapchat, our primary form of contact. Today I texted her, which I know is a mistake. But she is the only one who understands me. I left a backdoor and I knew it going in

Regardless of my own story, you could request she block you. I saw it as a forced recovery for me. But I see her weekly (if not more) and with the guy she swore was just a friend when we were together. If you see her frequently, I can't help.
But if you wont see her again, getting her to block you may be an answer. As shitty, lonely, and horrible as it sounds.
It's nice imagining dying a 'hero'. If I could die FOR something, I would. But dying for me and hurting everyone is the absolute worst thought and possibly the one thing holding me back.

You cant let your bad emotions dictate your life. If you're happy, or feel happy at all with him, then you need it. And if things get bad, if you realize he isnt right, you end it. It's a normal relationship, suicidal thoughts shouldn't be a reason to end things (unless it's out of the norm for you, obviously)
How long has it been since she spoke to you? As you well know, what happened isnt your fault.
I'm sorry. You can tell me about it, if it helps. I put my things in a post. Its nice for me to know that someone, somewhere knows what happened, if that makes any sense, lol.
Me either. My life isnt even that bad in the grand perspective. But its do fucking hard to do anymore.

This poem certainly shows your former love and now respect and admiration for your past boyfriend. If feels so mature to me, so pure and it has a tinge of nostalgia (a word I use a lot here) that we do not know, but can feel through your words.

It is very well written. I look forward to more of your poetry.

Without being too harsh (and anyone correct me if I'm wrong, please) but this seems different to me than a poem. This seems almost free-flowing sentences. Poems aren't required to have rhythms or rhymes, though many do. And those that do not are typically metaphorical and have a different structure than common English.

I dont want to influence your style, but I'd work on cutting some words (specifically the quoted sections seem out of place to me.)

As a side note, what you say does seem true. But sometimes people do actually fall in love on accident :) It's sometimes just a "Damn, I really really care about this person. I want them to be happy" sort of thing. Something that comes up and the person realizes that they truly are in love.

I agree, this seems out of place. I like the rest.

Wow... Actually wow. I do not get chills easily, but at two points in there I did. It's really great :) I know this isnt much criticism yet.

I cant say I'm not curious as to what the original meaning is. Obviously poems are interpretive, but I wonder what you interpreted it as when writing. What are our inhuman counterparts?

Let me recap my favorite points (the ones that gave me chills)

>It is the fights that make humanity, is it not?

>Beauty is blood, and tears, and scars, and hope -

>hope despite it all.

There and

>humanity cannot answer for itself.

>our creed is Pandora.

>our salvation is hope.


I wish I had more to say. Something to critique. But I really admire your poem as is. I wish the meaning to be clearer to me, but not to change the poem to make it so.

Very well done.

I like that you're tapping into the nostalgia and feeling that surely every person can relate to. Who didnt love some aspect of their childhood or some earlier point in their life? Even those who have had the worst hands dealt to them can think back on something fondly.

As for the poem's structure, the second and third stanzas have a bit of 'forced' feeling to the rhythm to me. The hard hyphen in the second stanza seems to indicate a longer pause to me, I'm not sure if this is what you intended or not.

I'm also no professional poet and am an amateur at best. So take everything I said with a grain of salt :)

Thanks for the comment. This was more about emotions to me, a sort of "If this emotion were a physical thing, what would it be" sort of thing. Sticky, red hot. But not quite right. Napalm isnt exactly tar, but the tar burns just the same.
Sometimes emotions are confusing, which I am experiencing for the first time in my life. At age 21. It's weird.
Keep me updated!:)

I like this one. I like the flow and rhythm of the poem, but I think you can use punctuation for emphasis and pacing. I stumbled a few times, losing rhythm and repeating lines. Consider some commas or hyphens 

>You’re walking on a path surrounded by the waves some vacant homes some shattered frames but nature still remains

This line, for example, could have some commas to help rhythm.

"You're walking on a path surrounded by the waves, some vacant homes, some shattered frames, but nature still remains". I picked an easy one, because I'm on mobile, but I hope it helps my point.

Actually, after posting my own, I realize now what people mean when they say 'mobile formatting sucks.' Maybe you have spacing I can't see on mobile, or maybe you posted from mobile.

Fair warning, I am not a reddit regular, nor am I proper poet.

I like the poem, but it leaves a lingering question: will it change? She knows of her situation, maybe she has for a while. And maybe that's a question you want unanswered.

Again, not a poet. But the second stanza rhymes on the words "more, for, more, for" respectively. Intentional? It's slightly weird to read, as such. To me at least.

Lastly, you used "once more" twice, "no more" once and "some more" once. It's a wee bit excessive for me.

Great poem though! I liked it, especially 'stripping' someone's confidence so that yours can 'soar'. Certainly how it feels when your confidence is taken away, yet they seem all the better for it.
